payload.posture: Read Mark 1:1–8 as one movement in John the Baptist's story, keeping the passage's actions, setting, sequence, and limits visible.
payload.tension: The passage states mark joins messenger and wilderness-voice language to John’s baptism, clothing, food, and announcement of one mightier than he. It does not by itself supply every cause or later interpretation of this part of John the Baptist's story.
